QuestInfo.name: Jane's Final Challenge
QuestInfo.0: #p103# says she will make me something even better.
QuestInfo.1: For this last experiment, #p103# promised to make me a mysterious scroll. For that, she needs #b1 #t4010107##k, #b20 #t4000050#s#k, and #b10 vials of #t2012002##k. Maybe I should ask the fairies in #m10002000# for the #t4010107#...
QuestInfo.2: I got the materials #p103# needed and the scroll for gloves was made without a hitch. Sweet! #p103# expressed a strong desire to keep experimenting. Maybe next time I return I'll be able to buy something from her that's not sold in stores...

0.0: Okay, this time, I'm feeling even more ambitious! Want to help me with my third-ever alchemy experiment?

yes.0: Thank you very much. Can you bring me #b1 #t4010107##k, #b20 #t4000050#s#k, and #b10 vials of #t2012002##k? And also, please take care of #r100 #o20#s#k and #r50 #o45#s#k. I think I might be able to create a mysterious scroll...

no.0: Well, now. If you don't have time to listen to a poor girl's plea... Fine, just let me know if you change your mind.

1.0: Ah! You got me #b1 #t4010107##k, #b20 #t4000050#s#k, and #b10 vials of #t2012002##k. Whew, I need a minute to mentally prepare myself...
1.1: While I do this, make sure you have an empty slot in your Use inventory. Okay, okay, breathe, breathe. Steady hands, and mix, and pour, and...

yes.0: Oh my. Oh my goodness. OH MY! I am sooooo talented! Look! I made a #rscroll for gloves#k! I think I'm going to faint from happiness. I couldn't have done it without you, so here, take it. It's yours.

item.0: You didn't bring me #b1 #t4010107##k, #b20 #t4000050#s#k, and #b10 vials of #t2012002##k. I heard that someone can create the #t4010107#, and I think the monsters will have the other two items. Good luck!

mob.0: Hmm... It looks like you haven't defeated all the monsters I asked you to.
